fields.title: Reader shortcodes: brackets that aren’t shortcodes
fields.content:
None of these brackets are shortcodes, so all of them should still show.

Prose: it was a good idea [sic]. Everyone laughed. [Laughter] The media [emphasis mine] said so. A claim.[1] I’ve taken on [REDACTED] duties. We posted in the [Facebook group]. The page had [crossed out letters] on it. [TL;DR] It’s short. Re: [MCN-Announce] A subject. Some [is being] quoted. Let [x = 5] and [a, b].

Shortcodes written out in code, escaped so WordPress doesn’t run them: [gallery ids="1,2"] and [[time]Oct 21 2026[/time]].

[[vc_row]][[vc_column]]Text[[/vc_column]][[/vc_row]]
[caption id="attachment_1"]A caption[/caption]

Escaped shortcodes in prose, which WordPress shows as text: [gallery ids="1,2"] and [caption]A caption[/caption].

The end.
